description: '''Rasan Chauki''' ([[Maithili language|Maithili]]: रसन चौकी) refers to a Mithila's traditional folk instrument group. The group plays Maithili folk sounds during religious ceremonies and cultural occasions in the [[Mithila (region)|Mithila region]] of the [[Indian subcontinent]]. It is often played during the festival of [[Mithila tradition of Durga Puja|Durga Puja]], religious ceremonies of [[Maithil Vivah]], Mundan, [[Maithil Upanayan]] and [[Chhath|Chhath Puja]], etc. It is a cultural heritage of the [[Maithils|Maithil]] community in the subcontinent. It is also known as the musical folk band of the Mithila region. It contains a group of five traditional instruments. It was first played during the legendary marriage between [[Rama|Lord Rama]] and [[Sita|Goddess Sita]] at the [[court of King Janaka]] in the ancient [[Videha|Mithila Kingdom]]. It is also called as ''Panchbajna'' or ''Naubat''.
